body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements a comprehensive timeline component inspired by Airtable, providing three distinct visualization styles for displaying temporal data through a schema-driven approach.

**Changes:**
- Added a new timeline UI component with support for vertical, horizontal, and Gantt-style layouts
- Created a timeline renderer that integrates with the Object UI schema system
- Added comprehensive examples in the prototype app demonstrating all three timeline variants

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/components/src/ui/timeline.tsx | Implements base UI components for all three timeline variants (vertical, horizontal, and Gantt-style) using Shadcn/Tailwind patterns |
| packages/components/src/ui/index.ts | Exports the new timeline components for consumption |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/timeline.tsx | Provides the schema-driven renderer with date calculations, formatting, and interactive features |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/index.ts | Registers the timeline renderer in the component registry |
| examples/prototype/src/App.tsx | Adds example schemas demonstrating vertical, horizontal, and Gantt timeline variants |
</details>
